text: Bolting: structural bolts M16 minimum, grade 8.8 hot-dip galvanised with matching nuts and washers; slip-critical and seismic connections grade 10.9 preloaded, galvanised or with a sherardised / zinc flake coating; anchor bolts galvanised, in sleeves to the OEM drawing. Welded connections in seismic force resisting systems shall use full penetration welds in the plastic hinge regions.
